verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is a self-hosted gateway that documents first-party channels for all five named messengers. WhatsApp and Telegram are marked production-ready, Discord supports DMs and guild channels, iMessage has native support, and Slack has rich-message support, so users chat from their existing apps rather than a bespoke page. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the messaging channels, and deeper first-party Slack setup docs (Slack is evidenced only by the channel list and a rich-messages page).

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page

citations.quote: Self-hosted gateway that connects Discord, Google Chat, iMessage, Matrix, Microsoft Teams, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Zalo, and more to AI coding agents.
Telegram is production-ready for bot DMs and groups via grammY.
OpenClaw connects to Discord as a bot over the official Discord gateway. DMs and guild channels are supported.
Native iMessage support via imsg (JSON-RPC over stdio), with private API actions for replies, tapbacks, effects, polls, attachments, and group management.
Run one Gateway process on your own machine and message your AI assistant from anywhere.
